body.x: DROGEN (CEO, Lee Heung Shin) took part in the ‘CES 2017’ held in Las Vegas in the United States from January 5th (Thu) to January 8th (Sun) by receiving support from Smart Drone Technology Center of Kyungpook National University and exhibited its 2017 new products as well as the existing ones such as Sports Drone, Toy Drone, and others.
DROGEN, which is a drone-specialized company with virtual gyro technology and motor design source technology, introduced the existing sports drone and new products soon to be released in ‘CES 2017.’

Robit 270G is a drone that features full-HD video capability and be a small size, so users can easily operate it and fly it for about 20 minutes on a single charge. PuzzleX 250, PuzzleX 230 that is planned to be released in January allows users and Pikaia1 to choose FC Module and be designed with carbon. It is possible for users to change its components and motors depending on personal taste.

Puzzle X 250GT to be released in March also allows Pikaia1 or users to choose FC Module, and its frame is designed with plastic (Diamond Grid Method). It is possible for users to change its components and motors depending on personal taste.

Also, the Daegu Technopark and Smart Venture Institute and Smart Drone Technology Center of Kyungpook National University opened ‘CES Daegu Common Facility’ and supported the exhibition operation of 22 domestic enterprises and business meeting with a buyer.

CES (Consumer Technology Show), which is the world’s largest IT consumer electronics and consumer technology tradeshow, is a good opportunity to figure out the flow of the global electronic industry at a glance and is held on every January by CTA (Consumer Technology Association).

Aving News Korea, which have reported issues of CES, MWC, and IFA as the world’ three major technology exhibitions the most for the last 10 years, will send a special group of reporters to CES, report main issues of the markets, and introduce Korean enterprises all over the world this year.
